scripts.build:types: node init && cd packages/types && npm run build
scripts.build:vault: node init && cd packages/vault-client && npm run build
scripts.build:packages: node init && npm run build:types && npm run build:vault
scripts.build:aggregator: node init && cd services/aggregator && npm run build
scripts.build:api: node init && cd api && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: node init && npm run build:packages && npm run build:aggregator && npm run build:api
scripts.build:contract: node init && cd contracts/price-oracle && cargo build --release
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:aggregator && npm run test:api
scripts.typecheck:all: cd packages/types && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../../packages/vault-client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../../services/aggregator && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../../api && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify:contract: cd contracts/price-oracle && cargo test && cd ../.. && node scripts/generate-verification-report.mjs
